page: Microsoft Azure E4-2as_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Easv7 server family. Powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with an x86_64 architecture, it features 2 vCPUs mapped to a single physical core with 2 threads. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz and is equipped with 32 MB of L3 cache. It is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 16.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Performance benchmarks reveal a strong contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The high clock speed of the AMD EPYC processor enables top-tier single-core CPU performance in stress-ng tests, alongside top-tier single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression speeds. However, due to the low core count, multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and PassMark tests falls into the lower tier. Memory bandwidth for large blocks is average, while small-block cached read bandwidth is relatively weak.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E4-2as_v7 offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. It is well-suited for relational databases with moderate query volumes, in-memory caching layers, lightweight enterprise applications, and single-threaded data processing tasks.
